The installed Home Assistant Hue implementation is not compatible with this integration version. Update Philips Hue Gradient Controller or Home Assistant, then reload the integration. No broad compatibility patch was applied.

selected_bridges_missing.description: The configured selection contains {count} unavailable Philips Hue v2 bridge entry or entries. A bridge may be disabled, removed, ignored, or no longer use Hue API v2. Open **Settings → Devices & services**, configure Philips Hue Gradient Controller, and update the bridge selection. This issue clears automatically after the integration reloads with a valid selection.
